preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= pi < i for i, pi in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: The parent array p must have exactly n-1 elements, where each pi is a valid parent index for vertex i (1 ≤ pi < i).

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the number of distinct possible colorings modulo 1000000007.

The output must equal the number of distinct possible colorings modulo 1000000007, where count_distinct_colorings(n, p) is the function that computes the number of distinct colorings based on the tree structure defined by n and p.
